systems.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system
systems.platform: operated under a public-private partnership with Banksforte Technology Limited
systems.tiers: commencement announced in Akwa Ibom State in July 2026; the Commission asks the state government to support full roll-out across the state; a partnership compact on decentralising birth registration signed with the Association of Local Governments of Nigeria, NIMC, UNICEF and the contractor

note: A national commission's civil registration platform starting in one state: the local government association is a signatory to a compact and is asked to cooperate, but no local government office is said to work in the system or to be connected.
